# Complete diagnosability with fallible witnesses

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

Two different Boolean answers cannot both be compatible with any complete report iff their admitted fault envelopes are CrossSeparated. Read on the process of inspection for every roster (Becoming.WitnessRefinementRuns), two candidates with different answers are told apart by every step on a complete transcript exactly where their envelopes are CrossSeparated (diagnosable_iff), and once a complete transcript is read, remaining cross-separated candidates agree at every later state (complete_run_agrees).

Canonical source: [WitnessRefinement.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/WitnessRefinement.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- Supplied roster, two fault envelopes, distinct answers, and complete reports on the roster.

Actual witnesses and joint failures must be covered; surviving-report fidelity, identity and recorder integrity are not generated by this theorem.

With no premise the core (Becoming.Readout) proves that, for different answers, no complete report of listed witnesses is explained both by one answer with some witnesses at fault and by the other with others at fault exactly where some witness is in neither fault set (no_common_report_iff), and, under admitted envelopes, exactly where every two admitted fault sets leave a common faithful witness (no_common_report_envelopes_iff); where every witness is in one of them, the report blaming one set explains both. On complete reports FallibleInspection's Boolean compatibility is the core's explanation under an admitted fault set (explains_complete_iff, compatible_complete_iff) and cross-separation is that common-witness condition, so complete_diagnosability_iff_cross_separation is the core law (complete_diagnosability_iff_by_core), proved without the periphery's classical step and with empty axiom reports (scratch build; the receipt comes with the landing); the list facts used are reproved in the bridge, since the library's use propext.
